title: Co-Designing AI For Mental Health Support With Young Adults of Color (YOC): Needs, Expectations, and Implications for AI Literacy

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation through participatory co-design workshops where Young Adults of Color (YOC) interacted with ChatGPT using mental health-related prompts, analyzing the model's responses for stereotyping, generic flattening of minority experiences, and lack of contextual understanding.

Analyzing AI chatbot responses to participant-generated prompts regarding specific cultural contexts (e.g., filial piety, household dynamics, immigration experiences) to identify incorrect cultural assumptions and the inability to contextualize systemic barriers.
